description: Detailed written and photographic specification of the materials you propose to use, including marked up versions of the approved elevations and roof plans showing where / how each of those materials are proposed to be used, detailed information about the roofline, including rainwater goods, and chimneys (detailed elevations and sections at 1:20), stucco and stone mouldings, and brick detailing (detailed elevations and sections at 1:10), boundary walls, railings and balustrades, and gates (detailed elevations and sections at 1:20), detailed drawings showing the revised arrangements and proportions of glazing bars to the windows and French doors, detailed drawings of a hard and soft landscaping scheme which includes the number, size, species and position of trees and shrubs, a detailed site investigation and remediation strategy for contamination and details of any external lighting strategy pursuant to condition 3, 5 (A), (C), (D), 6, 12, 17 and 21 of planning permission dated 29th July 2024 (RN: 24/01211/FULL)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
